name: @projexlight/connector-slack
summary: Slack workspace connector: install via OAuth, post to channels (with rate-aware queueing), receive slash commands + interactive components, and route Slack threads as conversation messages back to sdk-conversation. The canonical 'tell the team something happened' integration — sdk-notification routes Slack messages through here.

endpoints.description: Receive Slack Events API payloads (mentions, messages, threads).
Receive interactive component callbacks (button clicks, modal submits).

events.name: connector-slack.interaction.received.v1
events.description: User clicked an interactive component (button, modal submit).

events.name: connector-slack.thread.routed.v1
events.description: Inbound Slack thread routed as a conversation message to sdk-conversation.

models.description: Per-workspace row: team_id, team_name, bot_token_ref, installed_at.
Per-channel row: channel_id, name, archived, last_message_at.
Per-sent-message row: channel, ts, status, retry_count.
Per-interaction row: kind, user_id, payload, processed_at.

hooks.name: postMessage
hooks.description: Send a message to a channel. Rate-aware: queues when Slack rate-limits.

hooks.name: handleEvent
hooks.description: Process inbound Slack Events API payload.

hooks.name: startRetryWorker
hooks.description: Background worker: retries rate-limited outbound messages.

scenarios.title: Tenant admin installs the Slack app into their workspace
scenarios.when_to_use: First-time install via Slack OAuth; bot token stored vault-wrapped + scoped to the workspace.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Workspace row + bot-token vault-stored. Channels list discovered + cached.

scenarios.title: sdk-notification routes a 'storm declared' alert to #ops
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on notification.message.sent.v1 with channel: { kind: 'slack' } — connector formats + posts.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message posted; emits .message.sent.v1. If Slack returns 429, queued + retried with backoff.

scenarios.title: Operator clicks 'Approve' button in Slack → sdk-approval gate
scenarios.when_to_use: Interactive workflow — approval message sent to #compliance with Approve/Deny buttons; click flows into sdk-approval.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Interaction committed; emits .interaction.received.v1. sdk-approval picks it up + advances the approval workflow.

scenarios.title: Inbound Slack thread bridges to sdk-conversation
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer asks a question in their shared Slack channel; we route it as a sdk-conversation message so support agents see it in the unified inbox.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Thread routed to sdk-conversation; emits .thread.routed.v1. Reply in the unified inbox flows back to the Slack thread.

scenarios.title: Background worker retries rate-limited messages
scenarios.when_to_use: Slack rate-limits aggressively; the retry worker honors Retry-After headers + retries with exponential backoff.
scenarios.example_code:
import { startRetryWorker } from '@projexlight/connector-slack';
startRetryWorker({ tenant_id, interval_sec: 30 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Stale outbound messages re-attempted on their honor-after timestamp; emits .message.sent or .message.failed.

compliance_posture.notes: Bot tokens vault-wrapped. Signing-secret verification mandatory on inbound Events + Interactive endpoints; missing signature → 401. EU workspaces pin to EU API region.
